# FSM fixture provenance

`cases.jsonl` is unchanged from the `pre-simplify` tag. Its first JSONL record
records the reference commit, layouts, generation conventions and known deltas.
The reference is dac commit `fb1ef99`. The fixture contains 329 cases, including
one dattn-only case for the special-token convention.

The fixtures were regenerated by executing the reference implementation. They
were not copied from its test suite. Synthetic contexts contain no dataset text.
The header identifies the recorded model responses and their source benchmark.

The private-environment generator and response inputs were removed during
phase 1 of simplification. They remain recoverable at
`pre-simplify:tests/fixtures/fsm/make.py` and
`pre-simplify:tests/fixtures/fsm/responses.py`. The historical generator path in
the fixture header is preserved as provenance.

See [PROVENANCE.md](../../../docs/PROVENANCE.md) for attribution and the fixture
policy. The CPU FSM parity tests consume this fixture directly.
